name: Weather
reason: Folks, this week's forecast is lukewarm for algae: highs averaging only 25.3C with zero days above 30C and a soaking 17.3 mm of rain stirring the lake, so conditions lean against a bloom.
evidence: Average max temperature of 25.3C is warm but well below the 30C bloom-boosting threshold
Zero hot days (above 30C) this week, so no sustained heat to stratify the water
Rain total of 17.3 mm can mix and flush the water column
Early June timing means the lake is still warming up
